listening.title: A chat by the coffee machine

lines.speaker: Hoa (Marketing)
lines.text: Oh, hi! I don't think we've met properly before.

lines.speaker: Minh (HR)
lines.text: Hi! I'm Minh from HR. I started three weeks ago.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Marketing)
lines.text: I'm Hoa, marketing. Funny, we almost never cross paths in this building.

lines.speaker: Minh (HR)
lines.text: True. My desk is on the second floor, next to the vending machine.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Marketing)
lines.text: Lucky you. Ours only sells warm water after four in the afternoon.

lines.speaker: Minh (HR)
lines.text: I usually bump into people here at the coffee machine around ten.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Marketing)
lines.text: That's the best time. By the way, do you know Trang in design?

lines.speaker: Minh (HR)
lines.text: I do! She interviewed me. Nice to find a mutual connection so fast.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Marketing)
lines.text: Small company. Oh, there are leftovers from our workshop in the fridge.

lines.speaker: Minh (HR)
lines.text: Thanks, I'll take some. Anyway, my meeting starts in five minutes.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Marketing)
lines.text: Go ahead. Let's grab lunch next week and talk properly.

lines.speaker: Minh (HR)
lines.text: Sounds great. I'll message you on Teams later today.
